comparison.objective: Prune and dispose of a dead rose stem; candidate depins an electrical terminal for connector rework.
comparison.physical_skill: Secateur cutting while retaining an offcut versus guided dual-blade insertion, tang depression, and coordinated wire extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Requires a correctly located cut, intact bud, and disposal; candidate requires only the selected terminal removed with housing, crimp, and neighbors protected. Candidate force/damage thresholds remain unmeasured.
comparison.reason: Cutting plant material and retaining an offcut does not test release of recessed connector tangs.
